messages:
alex_p: Heads-up — AcmeHealth onprem activation is go for 2025-11-02 09:00 PT. Quick preflight checklist below, pinging owners.

alex_p: Checklist: 
- certs & CSR: customer uploaded to staging KMS?
- signed images pushed to airgapped registry
- firewall/NAT rules from customer and our egress proxy
- canary plan + rollback window (09:15 canary, 09:30 full)
- runbook owners assigned

lina_cs: Customer confirmed people on call + maintenance window. HSM key material delivered to their security mailbox yesterday. They still need to ACK the CSR fingerprint. I can nudge them now. :thumbsup:

jen_sre: Firewall rules still show missing entries for the metrics endpoint (TCP 9090) and the control plane (TCP 443) from their jump-host CIDR. I posted the exact CIDRs in the ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ACME-412

sam_se: Image signing is the blocker for me. The onprem registry auth works but the signed manifest for v2.1 didn't land in the mirror. I started a fresh sign job, ETA ~20m. If it fails we'll default to unsigned + stricter runtime verification (needs rollback doc updated).

alex_p: @sam_se can you post the signing log output here when done? Also tagging @jen_sre for firewall once we have CIDRs.

sam_se: paste: ```
[2025-11-01T16:12:04Z] signing job started
[2025-11-01T16:17:11Z] pushed signed manifest: registry.local/acme/v2.1:sha256:abcd1234
[2025-11-01T16:17:12Z] replicate -> mirror staging succeeded
```
Looks clean on our side.

jen_sre: Received. Customer still needs to open egress to our NAT pool 34.82.14.0/24 and allow inbound from their jump-host 10.8.0.0/24 to control-plane 443. Once they confirm I'll schedule a smoke with the prober.

lina_cs: Nudge sent to Acme infra lead (cody@acmehealth). He says ops will add rules before EOD PT. If they miss it we have a fallback: run canary inside their VPN with temporary port-forwarding via bastion (requires ops signoff).

mark_oncall: I'm happy to own the canary at 09:15. I'll run the smoke checklist and report TLDR + artifacts to the thread. Who is doing rollback if the canary fails?

alex_p: @mark_oncall — thanks. Ownership: canary = mark_oncall, rollback lead = sam_se, network escalation = jen_sre, CS liaison = lina_cs. I'll update the runbook.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: canary-deploy/acmehealth v2.1 at 2025-11-02T09:15:00-08:00 (ID: canary-178999). Notifying oncall.

sam_se: Noted. I'll be on standby at 09:00 PT in case we need the hotfix branch. SLA for rollback decision = 10 minutes after canary start.

jen_sre: Small ops note — for airgap image pull we need signed manifest + registry certificate chain installed on their mirror. Lina, confirm ops has the cert chain (I uploaded to the ticket).

lina_cs: Confirmed, cert chain uploaded and customer acknowledged receipt. Ops will install before 20:00 PT.

alex_p: Outstanding action items summary: 
- customer to add NAT CIDR & jump-host allowlist (Cody) — Lina to confirm when done
- sam_se to verify signed manifest replicate (done)
- jen_sre to run prober once CIDRs in place
- mark_oncall to run canary and post results
- alex_p to update runbook with owner matrix + rollback flow

alex_p: If no blockers by EOD PT, we keep 09:00 activation. If firewall or cert pieces miss EOD, we move to the fallback plan and notify customer 1h before window.

lina_cs: I'll post an update to the customer thread when NAT is applied.

mark_oncall: :thumbsup: I'll make a short checklist artifact and pin it after the canary.

sam_se: One more thing — QA found a minor metric label regression in 2.1; it doesn't affect availability but will bloat logs. If we hit noisy metrics during canary I'll flip the metrics filter (5m). Not a blocker unless telemetry spikes.

alex_p: Good call. Add that to the runbook under 'canary mitigations'. Thanks everyone.

jen_sre: I'll drop a quick smoke run report here after we see firewall changes.

(10:58 PM) deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: canary-deploy/acmehealth v2.1 -> 2025-11-02T09:15 PT.
